name: BullMQ
solves: Provides a Redis-based distributed job queue and message processing system for Node.js and Python with support for job priorities, delayed jobs, rate limiting, repeatable jobs, parent-child job dependencies, and sandboxed workers, all backed by atomic Lua scripts for rock-solid reliability.
best_for: Distributed background job processing in Node.js/Python apps requiring Redis-backed reliability and atomicity
Complex job workflows with parent-child dependency trees using FlowProducer
Rate-limited or priority-based task queues where jobs need delayed execution, retries, and repeatable scheduling
NestJS applications needing a mature job queue via the official @nestjs/bullmq integration
High-throughput message processing pipelines requiring concurrency control, pause/resume, and global events
skip_when: Your project cannot run or manage a Redis instance as infrastructure
You need a fully managed hosted solution with zero infrastructure overhead
You only need simple periodic cron-like scheduling without queuing semantics
Your stack is serverless-first (e.g., Vercel/Cloudflare Workers) with no persistent worker processes
You prefer a PostgreSQL-backed queue to avoid adding Redis as a dependency
